title: Information-Theoretic Channel Capacity of Concept Probes

original_idea.body: Estimate mutual information between concept projection and label to rank concept-probe 'channel capacity'. Inference-only, no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: an MI-based reliability metric for fuzzy safety monitors helps, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Binning/MINE-lite MI estimation on projections; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (MI ranking of concepts), few dependencies (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly fuzzy-concept evaluation on open models (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: MI estimation on cached projections, near free-tier (level 5).

novelty.reasoning: MI is standard but applying channel-capacity ranking to concept probes may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: MI probing exists; the channel-capacity ranking of safety concepts may add novelty.
